svg.title: A consistency proof from 3 entries to 7
svg.desc: The old tree of 3 entries has root H(g, c). The new tree of 7 has root H(k, l) with k = H(g, h) and h = H(c, d). The proof is c, d, g, l. From c and g the verifier rebuilds the old root; from c, d, g and l it rebuilds the new root. Both must match the signed roots, which proves the first three entries were not changed.

text.tspan: check against the old signed head
check against the new signed head
the same c and g build both roots: the old tree is still inside the new one.
change any of d0, d1, d2 and no proof can make both roots come out right.
